textos.Enquanto cerca de metade de quem recomen: While about half of those who recommend it highlight the non-linear, intricate narrative structure, about half of those who do not recommend it point to the excessively slow, long pacing. In addition, this second group misses an approach to the human impact caused by the weapon.
textos.O filme é longo demais, com muitas conve: The film is far too long, with a lot of conversation and little action, which makes it tiring and boring.
textos.A narrativa é complexa artificialmente,: The narrative is artificially complex, with time cuts that make it hard to understand and feel more like an attempt to seem smart.
textos.As mulheres são reduzidas a estereótipos: Women are reduced to stereotypes, appearing mainly in nudity and sex scenes that have no relevance to the plot.

textos.A história gira excessivamente em torno: The story revolves excessively around the individual genius, ignoring the collective context and the victims.
textos.A música e a edição são boas, mas não sa: The music and the editing are good, but they do not save the film from visual monotony and a lack of depth.
textos.O filme se estende demais, com muitas ce: The film stretches on too long, with many dialogue scenes and little action, making the experience tiring and even boring at several moments.
textos.O elenco é um dos pontos altos, com dest: The cast is one of the high points, especially the performances of Cillian Murphy and Robert Downey Jr., who elevate the material.
textos.A fotografia, a direção de arte e o uso: The cinematography, the art direction and the use of the IMAX format impress, although the practical effects of the explosion fall short for some.
textos.A estrutura não linear com muitos cortes: The non-linear structure with many cuts and time jumps makes the story hard to follow, leaving the plot tiring and not very fluid.
textos.O filme não aprofunda a psicologia do pr: The film does not delve into the protagonist's psychology, leaving his motivations and inner conflicts superficial, which prevents a stronger emotional connection.
textos.A trilha sonora é um dos destaques, cont: The score is one of the highlights, contributing to the film's intense atmosphere, although at some moments it can sound too dominant.
textos.O desempenho de Cillian Murphy no papel: Cillian Murphy's performance in the lead role is frequently praised as award-worthy, conveying the complexity and emotional weight of the character; Robert Downey Jr. is also singled out for his intense, transformative performance.
textos.A música de Ludwig Göransson é considera: Ludwig Göransson's music is considered exceptional, raising the tension and the atmosphere of the film, although some find the volume too loud at certain moments.
textos.A direção de fotografia e os efeitos prá: The cinematography and the practical effects create striking images, especially in the sequences that illustrate the scale and intensity of the project.
textos.A estrutura temporal fragmentada é desaf: The fragmented time structure is challenging to follow, with multiple timelines, but many appreciate how it reflects the protagonist's mind.
textos.Embora a duração de três horas seja cons: Although the three-hour running time is considered justifiable for the depth of the story, some viewers feel that the pace drags in certain parts, especially at the beginning.
textos.Exploração de culpa e consequências mora: Exploration of guilt and moral consequences
textos.O filme aborda a responsabilidade e o pe: The film addresses the responsibility and the moral weight of creating a weapon of mass destruction, prompting deep reflections on science and politics.

textos.Lançado em 2023 sob a direção de Christo: Released in 2023 and directed by Christopher Nolan, Oppenheimer is a feature film in the drama and history genres. The work follows the biography of the American physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer, exploring in detail his fundamental role in leading the Manhattan Project and in creating the atomic bomb during the Second World War, as well as the way these events changed world history forever.
textos.A experiência de exibição estrutura-se p: The viewing experience is structured through a fragmented, complex and non-linear narrative, leading the events across a markedly long running time and with a prolonged pace.
textos.Em termos de recepção, os grupos concent: In terms of reception, the groups focus their analyses on the same factual aspects of the production, disagreeing mainly in their verdict on its overall effectiveness. In the vast majority of ratings (~85%), a significant share highlights the standout performances of the cast, while a good portion praises the technical impact of the score and the sound, and several stress the vigor shown by the cinematography and the impressive visual effects.
textos.Para a perspectiva expressa numa fração: For the perspective expressed in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~11%), many point to discomfort with the slow pace and excessive running time, although a considerable number maintain that the performances are praised and a portion mentions the visual and technical quality. By contrast, from the viewpoint of those in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~3%), most condemn the slow pace and excessive running time, accompanied by a significant share that rejects the script as pretentious and confusing, as well as some who criticize underdeveloped female characters.
